title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation to Support Railways Engineering Tasks: A Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2607.01244v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The growing number and complexity of technical regulations represent an important challenge for all professionals in regulated industries. This paper describes a case study, from design to deployment, of building a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for the consultation of complex technical regulations in the railway domain. Although developed for the railway sector, this testimony of an industrial experience is of particular value for technical domains where regulatory compliance and accurate information retrieval from complex documentation are essential requirements. It also constitutes a human-centered approach for implementing LLM-powered technical documentation consultation across various regulated industries, balancing technological capabilities with domain expertise.

translated_title: 支持铁路工程任务的检索增强生成：一项案例研究
translated_abstract: 技术法规数量的不断增长及其日益复杂性，对所有受监管行业的从业者构成了重大挑战。本文描述了一个案例研究，涵盖从设计到部署的全过程，即构建一个用于查询铁路领域复杂技术法规的检索增强生成（RAG）系统。尽管该系统是为铁路行业开发的，但这一工业实践经验对于监管合规性以及从复杂文档中准确检索信息为基本需求的技术领域具有特殊价值。同时，它还提供了一种以人为中心的方法，用于在各受监控行业中实施基于大语言模型的技术文档查询服务，并实现了技术能力与领域专业知识之间的平衡。
tldr: 本文通过铁路领域的案例研究，展示了从设计到部署检索增强生成（RAG）系统以查询复杂技术法规的完整工业实践经验，为受监控行业提供了一种以人为中心、平衡技术与领域专业知识的LLM文档查询实施方案。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an industrial case study, from design to deployment, of building a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for consulting complex railway technical regulations, offering a human-centered approach for implementing LLM-powered documentation consultation across regulated industries.
